purpose: Provenance for the painted Expedition Basecamp backdrop (layers named by basecamp.json). Machine-readable authority; verified by tests/integration/basecamp-painted-assets.test.ts and the client bundle scan. Refresh after replacing a picture: node tests/scripts/refresh-painted-provenance.mjs
source: OpenArt nano-banana-2 image2image, owner-approved selection on November 7, 2026
storage: normal Git blobs (no Git LFS rule matches the runtime directory)
formats: JPEG or WebP for opaque layers; PNG or WebP with alpha for layers with transparency
measurements: basecamp.json fractions measured on the single-layer full image (6336x2688, OpenArt historyId Ds9G8dslCXUxiQyLHEj5): groundY 0.900 is the middle of the path band (top surface 0.84 to 0.956). signpostX measured by eye on the same image.

basecamp-far.jpg.derivation: 6336x2688 RGB PNG resized (Lanczos) to 1600 px tall, JPEG quality 82, progressive

basecamp-mid.webp.role: front layer (buildings, trees, gate, path; transparent sky), parallax 1
basecamp-mid.webp.derivation: 6336x2688 RGBA PNG resized (Lanczos) to 1600 px tall, WebP with alpha quality 82
